name: Halekulani
insider_take: The Halekulani isn't just a hotel—it's a living piece of Hawaiian royalty that has been the crown jewel of Waikiki Beach since 1917.
whats_special: This legendary oceanfront sanctuary features the world-famous Orchid Pool with over 1.2 million glass mosaic tiles forming a stunning cattleya orchid on the pool floor. The hotel's name literally means "house befitting heaven" in Hawaiian, and it has hosted everyone from royalty to Hollywood legends. The property sits on the exact spot where Queen Liliuokalani once had her beach house.
pro_tip: Book the Diamond Head Oceanfront Suite for unobstructed views of both Diamond Head crater and Waikiki Beach—it's the same vista that inspired countless artists and writers over the past century.
dont_miss: Sunday brunch at Orchids restaurant with live Hawaiian music, and cocktails at Lewers Lounge where the bartenders have been perfecting their craft for decades. The hotel's spa treatments using native Hawaiian ingredients like kukui nut oil and volcanic clay are truly transformative.
pros: Legendary luxury resort with timeless Hawaiian elegance and impeccable service
Prime Waikiki Beach location with stunning oceanfront views
Iconic orchid pool mosaic and world-class spa facilities
Award-winning dining including renowned La Mer restaurant
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
